experience.title: Experience
experience.subtitle: Where I have built my career.
experience.items.mid.intro: I work as a Software Developer on Proteo, an insurtech startup project, building backend solutions in C# and .NET — a microservices architecture with multiple REST APIs, BFFs and databases, integrated with financial institutions. I also contribute to the frontend with React, and use AI tools as productivity aids without giving up full understanding of the code I ship.
experience.items.mid.desc.first: Designed and implemented the end-to-end payment collection flow, from payment slip issuance and file upload to AWS through to bank callback processing and payment settlement.
experience.items.mid.desc.second: Built integrations with financial institutions, including Itaú, ensuring reliable and secure communication between internal microservices and external banking systems.
experience.items.mid.desc.third: Implemented performance improvements that reduced page load times by 40%, significantly increasing user retention.
experience.items.mid.desc.fourth: Contributed to frontend features using React, supporting a more end-to-end development experience across the stack.
experience.items.junior.intro: After being promoted from intern to Junior Developer, I worked on full-stack development of new features for web-based systems — building dynamic front-end interfaces with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and back-end logic with C# and ASP.NET MVC. I also participated in Scrum ceremonies and technical meetings with stakeholders, aligning technology decisions with business needs.
experience.items.junior.desc.first: Implemented unit and integration tests, increasing test coverage and helping reduce production issues.
experience.items.junior.desc.second: Conducted root cause analysis of critical bugs reported in production, accelerating resolution and improving system reliability.
experience.items.junior.desc.third: Collaborated with the design team to align interface behavior with user expectations, contributing to a smoother user experience.
experience.items.intern.intro: I began my journey in web development as an intern, supporting the maintenance of existing applications and applying C# and ASP.NET MVC in back-end development, while building proficiency in HTML, CSS and JavaScript for front-end tasks. This role marked my first experience with the agile Scrum methodology.
experience.items.intern.desc.first: Implemented usability improvements on the front-end by fixing CSS and JavaScript bugs that affected user experience.
experience.items.intern.desc.second: Created detailed technical documentation for new features, helping onboard new team members more efficiently.
experience.items.intern.desc.third: Developed routine C# scripts to automate data import tasks, allowing the senior team to focus on higher-priority projects.
